description: Retrieve how alliances advanced through each playoff level at an event. Returns one entry per level (e.g., double-elimination rounds, round robin semifinals, finals) with the level type, ranked alliances (team keys, alliance name and color, record, matches played, sort orders, extra stats), and metadata describing each sort order and extra stat. Returns an empty list for events without computed playoff advancement.

event_key.description: TBA event key combining the season year and event code (e.g., '2023casj' for the 2023 Silicon Valley Regional, '2024txhou' for the 2024 Houston Championship, '2024micmp4' for a Michigan State Championship division). Use get_events or get_events_keys to discover valid event keys for a year.

name: get_event_playoff_advancement
title: Get Event Playoff Advancement
